baseline: Master with literal Boolean specialization, which copies TreeLayerAt for each literal
candidate: The base revision plus the aggregate-work guard and the dead reload removal
methodology: Physical Alpha, checks off, learning off. Widgets: the staged Kryon 3627ea8a Button and Input cases built by each revision, plus the published artifacts measured before Boolean specialization, all run by the staged native runner and Node; each round runs the three programs of one widget and target in rotated order under the host gate, with stdout and result checked against the staged row, 11 batch samples per run and symmetric 1.5xIQR per run. Standard: standard-ab with each revision's in-process runner and bundle, pinned to CPU 3, 7 rounds of 11 samples, every run checked against the C digest.

sample_statistics.rule: Tukey 1.5×IQR fences; linearly interpolated inclusive quartiles; both tails; raw samples retained
